title: Esque Douglas and the Virginia Ravens
summary: Esque Douglas, an upperclassman clarinetist, worked with the Virginia Ravens, which also had Eddie Mallory and possibly Doc Cheatham.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: But there was a fellow, too, by the name of Esque Douglas, who worked with the band.
Esque. That's his name, E-s-q-u-e. He worked with a band, Stan, called the Virginia Ravens. He was an upperclassman.
Tremendous musician. He was a clarinetist. And he had a lot to do with the things that gave me a chance to ... later
Virginia Ravens, that's like a band that tours around, isn't that right?
The Virginia Ravens was a band back in the '20s.
Yes, I think Eddie Barefield told me about that.
Yes, a tremendous band. A fellow by the name of Eddie Mallory played in that band. And I think Doc Cheatham (?) played in that band but I'm not too sure.
